question: [阅读理解B] （B） Have you ever heard of Zhang Guimei? She is a teacher in Yunnan Province. In 2008, she set up a free high school for girls in a poor area. She got up at 5 a.m. and went to bed after midnight every day. She visited students' homes to ask their parents to send their children to school. Thanks to her, more than 1,800 girls have gone to college. Her school has changed their lives. She said, 'I want to help these girls get a better future.' Because their families were poor. C. Because there were no schools. D. Because they were too young. （ ）4. How many girls have gone to college thanks to her? A. More than 800. B. More than 1,000. C. question: [书面表达] （20分）请以「My English Learning」为题，写一篇短文，介绍你学习英语的情况。 提示：①你对英语的看法；②你学习英语的方法（如听英文歌、看英文电影、背单词、读英文文章等）；③你在英语学习中遇到的困难；④今后的打算。 要求：词数100左右；语句通顺，意思连贯；不得出现真实姓名。
answer:
范文：
My English Learning
I think English is very important and useful. It is a bridge to the world.
I have my own ways to learn English. First, I listen to English songs and watch English movies. This helps me improve my listening. Second, I keep a word notebook and try to remember ten new words every day. Third, I read English stories after class.
Of course, I have some problems. Speaking is the most difficult for me. I'm afraid of making mistakes.
In the future, I will practice speaking more and be braver. I believe I can learn English well.
explanation:
【解析】评分标准：
一类（17—20分）：要点齐全，语言流畅，语法正确，衔接自然。
二类（13—16分）：要点较全，语言基本通顺，有少量语法错误。
三类（9—12分）：要点基本齐全，语言有较多错误，但能达意。

question: [阅读理解A] （A） The smartphone has changed our lives greatly. It brings us a lot of convenience. With a smartphone, we can do many things. We can call and message others easily. We can search for information on the Internet. We can take photos, listen to music and watch videos. We can also shop online and pay for things without cash. However, smartphones also bring problems. Some people spend too much time on their phones. They play games or watch videos for hours. This is bad for their eyes and health. Some students even use phones in class, which affects their study. Some people become less patient and talk less with their family. So we should use smartphones properly. We shouldn't use them too much. We should spend more time with our family and friends. （ ）1. What does the passage talk about? A. The history of smartphones. B. The good and bad points of smartphones. C. How to buy a smartphone. D. The price of smartphones. （ ）2. Which is NOT mentioned as a use of smartphones? A. Calling others. B. Searching for information. C. Driving a car. D. Shopping online. （ ）3. What problem can smartphones bring? A. They make us rich. B. They are bad for our eyes and health. C. They make us smarter. D. They help us study better. （ ）4. What should we do with smartphones? A. Use them as much as possible. B. Never use them. C. Use them properly. D. Only use them for games. （ ）5. What's the writer's attitude towards smartphones? A. Completely against. B. Completely supportive. C. Objective (客观的). D. Not clear.
answer: 1. B（讲手机的优缺点）　2. C（文中未提到开车）　3. B（bad for eyes and health）　4. C（use them properly）　5. C（作者既讲优点又讲缺点，态度客观）
explanation: 【解析】评分：每题2分。

question: [阅读理解B] （B） Yuan Longping is known as the 'Father of Hybrid Rice'. He was born in 1930 in Beijing. When Yuan Longping was young, he saw many people die of hunger. He decided to study agriculture and help people grow more food. After many years of hard work, he developed hybrid rice in the 1970s. This new kind of rice could produce much more than ordinary rice. It helped feed millions of people in China and other countries. Yuan Longping worked in the fields even when he was old. He said, 'I have two dreams. One is to enjoy the cool under the rice crops taller than men. The other is to make hybrid rice cover the whole world.' He passed away in 2021, but his spirit will live forever. （ ）1. What is Yuan Longping known as? A. The Father of Rice. B. The Father of Hybrid Rice. C. The Father of Agriculture. D. The Father of Science. （ ）2. Why did Yuan Longping decide to study agriculture? A. Because he liked plants. B. Because he wanted to be famous. C. Because he saw people die of hunger. D. Because his parents asked him to. （ ）3. When did he develop hybrid rice? A. In the 1950s. B. In the 1960s. C. In the 1970s. D. In the 1980s. （ ）4. What was one of Yuan Longping's dreams? A. To be a rich man. B. To enjoy the cool under tall rice crops. C. To travel around the world. D. To write a book. （ ）5. What can we learn from Yuan Longping? A. We should work hard and help others. B. We should always rest. C. We should only care about ourselves. D. We should give up easily.
answer: 1. B（Father of Hybrid Rice）　2. C（he saw many people die of hunger）　3. C（in the 1970s）　4. B（enjoy the cool under the rice crops taller than men）　5. A（从他身上学到努力工作、帮助他人）

question: [任务型阅读] （C）任务型阅读 Chinese traditional festivals are an important part of Chinese culture. Each festival has its own meaning and customs. Mobile phones bring us a lot of convenience. We can call others, search for information, shop online and pay for things easily.
However, using phones too much can cause problems. It is bad for our eyes and health. Some students even use phones in class, which affects their study. Some people talk less with their family because of phones.
